CustomField.label: Group Key
CustomField.description: Idempotency key of the request, set by the publishing Flow: <source record Id>:<request type>:<product line code>, e.g. 006...:DEACTIVATION:NEON_CRM. Unique, so a second row for the same record, type and line is impossible at the database level (the Flow checks first and swallows the fault). External Id for MuleSoft lookups.
